author: CoreDisruption
body: Recently, I was banned by the Senior Moderator ,GrapeSmoothie, for advertising. I completely understand for I was repeatedly typing the IP of another server. However, I had copied and pasted it earlier, and still thought I had the command /play copied so I could quickly get in and start playing one of my favorite games. As I pasted two or three times in chat, I remembered that I had an IP copied. If you would unban me, I would appreciate it. If not I still understand.

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

After checking your logs, your story seems to be true indeed. In the future, be more careful when you copy and paste things into chat, thanks!

Regards,
Pelpelajax.
